{{Quote|She commands a phalanx for a rival syndic, one who doesn't approve of the changes I'm encouraging. And I know she wouldn't approve of you, either.|Assistant Syndic Soontir Fel|<ref name="Refugee" />}}
An individual had a rank of a '''[[Syndic/Legends|syndic]]''' in a [[Ruling Families/Legends|ruling]] [[Unidentified Chiss family|family]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. The syndic was in charge of a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Unidentified phalanx|phalanx]] and was opposed to [[Assistant Syndic]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] and [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx]].<ref name="Refugee" />

According to the account given by [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]]<ref name="Joiner King" /> in [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="Joiner King Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].</ref> the Chiss family to which the syndic belonged had been destroyed by Soontir Fel during a [[Chiss civil conflict|civil conflict]] between the Chiss, which led to the syndic's opposition to Fel's policies.<ref name="Joiner King" />
